This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

After the Cold War, the US military retired hundreds of Cobra attack helicopters — but decommissioning them means cutting the airframe into pieces so it can never fly again. Montana mechanic Ron Garlick found a legal loophole, rebuilt a Vietnam-era Cobra gunship, and used it for logging, firefighting, film work, and hunting coyotes with rockets and machine guns.
